notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]1.0.2 Patch[/h2]

[list]
[*] Extended building in 3-2 to fix balcony softlock
[*] Fixed multiple issues with level select beyond chapter 1
[*] Fixed virtue icons taking too long to change color
[*] Click sound now plays when adjusting volume settings
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]1.0.1 Patch[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed "Next" button disappearing on Chapter 1 level select
[*] Removed outdated "enemies delay next strike when blocking" tip
[*] Added new tip to 1-1
[*] Moved "parrying" tip to 1-2
[*] Removed "Alpha" label on main menu (oops)
[*] Fixed Blade of Two and Reflexes achievements not triggering
[/list]

notes.content: [list][*][p]Increased Soldier (big guy) range when deciding to block/attack[/p][list][*][p]Slightly harder to rush a kill, but still possible[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can now press the attack or block button/key to exit meditation[/p][/*][*][p]Added Discord and YouTube links to main menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.1.0 - Small Update
notes.content: [p]0.1.0 - Small Update[/p][list][*][p]Increased attack speed buff after striking or blocking an enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased vertical size of player attack hitbox[/p][/*][*][p]Very slightly reduced Swordsman attack size[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad input now hides the mouse cursor[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the resume button to the top of the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]You can now go backwards in cutscenes by hitting the block button[/p][/*][*][p]You can now skip text scroll in cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Menus can now be controlled by gameplay inputs (attack, block, and directional inputs set in options)[/p][/*][*][p]Made main menu slide animation slightly slower[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked size of game window when not fullscreen[/p][/*][*][p]Added link to YouTube channel in credits screen[/p][/*][/list]
